reserveReview.rationale: The newest Zephyr reserve snapshot, captured_at 2026-10-17T15:17:42.772Z at reserve_height 887405, was still the latest record in the series when observed on 2026-10-29 (569 snapshots returned, descending). It reports on_chain.zeph_reserve_atoms 4877686188547337100 (4,877,686.188547337 ZEPH) and zsd_circ_atoms 383960207767254379 (383,960.2077672544 ZSD). The scanner documentation identifies zeph_in_reserve as ZEPH locked in the DJED reserve. The complete single-asset reserve remains one 100% ZEPH slice, unchanged from the October 10 review; the snapshot's reserve_ratio 3.819930 is a coverage observation, not a composition weight, and it replaced the October 10 ratio of 4.014344 because reserve and circulating amounts moved. This review establishes reserve composition from the issuer's itemized native reserve snapshot and documented asset identity. It does not assert an independently pinned daemon read, an independent attestation, a liquidation horizon, or legal custody protection.
